quarterly_data.signal: Datasection made its subsidiary Datasection (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (DSTH; Bangkok; established 01-21-2026; business: AI data center operation; 99.99% owned) the operating entity of the data center the company is opening in the Kingdom of Thailand, and completed a capital increase into it on 09-30-2026 as the business expands, making DSTH a specified subsidiary with capital of THB 675,086,000 (JPY 3,166 million). Because DSTH's importance to the group has grown, it will be consolidated from Q2 of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (previously an unconsolidated subsidiary). The company expects no material impact on consolidated results from the capital increase.
